params.1273: Help heroes and villagers traverse Mort Myre in Temple Trekking.
params.1274: You can find villagers seeking safe passage through Mort Myre in Burgh de Rott.
params.1275: You can also find adventurers seeking passage to Burgh de Rott next to the Paterdomus.
params.1276: Check the noticeboard and select who you want to escort.
params.1277: You should start on the easy routes and increase the difficulty as you get stronger.
